text_block_list.text:
While out and about—Tap Dance City
suddenly stopped in front of a crane game.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look at that!
It's a mountain of treasure!
choice_data_list: A treasure... you mean Paka Puchi?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! The history they continue to carve out
is a treasure that will shine forever!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: That one won the Japan Cup, and that other one won the Arima Kinen... Haha, I can picture those legendary races right before my eyes!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to fall behind either.
Someday, I'll rewrite history!

Looking at the Paka Petit seems to stoke Tap Dance City's fighting spirit.
If that's the case—
choice_data_list: I'll win a Paka Petit for you.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Really?
I'd appreciate it, but are you sure?"
choice_data_list: Because it should be good stimulation for Tap

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's your strategy!
If we're doing this, let's take everything they've got, Navigator!
—I can't afford to lose this game!!
